title: Author the test-report contract and validator
description: Add contracts/schemas/v1/test-report.schema.json (required: schema_version const 1.0, project, generated_at date-time, command, tests_total, tests_passed, tests_failed, tests_skipped; counts integer minimum 0; additionalProperties false; enum-free). Add validateTestReport to cli/lib/validate.js (mirroring validateBuildReport), export it, import it in cli/appbuilder.js and add it to module.exports, and append 'test-report' to REQUIRED_SCHEMA_NAMES. Test-first: add validateTestReport unit tests (valid report passes; missing/!=0-count report fails).
acceptance_criteria: test-report.schema.json validates the eight required fields with enum-free, integer-minimum-0 counts.
validateTestReport is exported from cli/lib/validate.js and re-exported from cli/appbuilder.js.
